title: Universal Type-I 2D→3D→4D Composition + Seed Graph Matrix

owner.rule: Composition/projection layer only; it does not replace the 411×60 archetype matrix, component-instance register, UTP-146 radiative/transport owner, UTP-147 stack normal form or UTP-148 maturity/invalidation graph.

purpose: Map 2D functional intent into non-planar 3D regions/interfaces and then into 4D state/history under seedless, single-seed and multi-seed topologies so PrintSpace/CGX can compile, ingest, invalidate and mature evidence without promoting unsupported physical capability.

semantics.2d: Schematic/net/function intent only; symbols do not imply dimensions, process compatibility or ratings.
semantics.3d: Directed region/interface graph of solids, films, cavities, voids, conductors, dielectrics, references, barriers, interlayers, seed packages, service volumes and local frames.
semantics.4d: Time/state/history of the same 3D article across electrical, thermal, mechanical, magnetic, optical, fluidic, chemical/electrochemical, logic, calibration, health and uncertainty. Frequency/phase/modal views are derived, not extra spatial dimensions.
semantics.evidence: NUMERIC only when all consequential inputs are attributable and the selected model/regime is valid; otherwise SYMBOLIC or HOLD.
semantics.authority: No record creates machine-program, physical execution, certification, public release, legal/financial, extraction/orbital or high-consequence authority.

seed_graphs.SG-0: No imported specialist seed supplies the declared function; all mechanisms require locally qualified material/process/test evidence.
seed_graphs.SG-1: One exact seed supplies a bounded mechanism; printed/hybrid surroundings retain their own evidence ceiling.
seed_graphs.SG-N: Multiple seeds require explicit directed coupling/failure edges; system evidence is bounded by the weakest required node/edge.

capacitance_inference_ladder.gate: Uniform-field approximation, geometry and εr state attributable; fringe/guard corrections where consequential.
Each thickness, εr(f,T,RH), interface/void state and overlap bound.
Concentric long-cylinder approximation; end effects negligible or corrected.
Concentric-sphere assumptions/material state valid; other boundaries use their own model.
Maxwell capacitance matrix from attributable field solve/measurement; never force parallel-plate law.

capacitance_inference_ladder.equation: Use C' in R'L'G'C' or full-wave field solution
capacitance_inference_ladder.gate: Frequency/geometry justify distributed model; dispersion/loss/ports/boundaries bound.
State dependence/hysteresis/motion and energy accounting explicit; no static-C extrapolation.

global_invariants: X→Y process compatibility is directional; X→Y never implies Y→X.
A cavity/void may shape fields, flow, thermal resistance, compliance or access but is not an energy source.
Geometry only couples/stores/dissipates energy through a present physical mechanism.
Seed certification/rating never transfers to printed surroundings.
Unsupported pair/hyperedge coupling remains OPEN/HOLD and cannot be filled by AI consensus.
Consequential source/geometry/material/process/calibration/seed/environment changes route through UTP-148 before dependent results are reused.
Dense P10 integration cannot bypass required P0-P9 child/interface evidence.
Recovered/local material remains a candidate until identity, cleaning, characterization, process compatibility and coupon evidence pass.

proof_binding.digital: 20/20 primitive coverage + SG-0/1/N + 2D/3D/4D fields + capacitance ladder + fail-closed lookup.
proof_binding.physical: P0-P10 remains the physical owner; first witnesses remain P0 identity, P1 conductor, P2 separate R/C/L, then P3 resonator/field.
proof_binding.maturity: UTP-148 advances only proven axes and invalidates dependent results on changed evidence.
proof_binding.no_promotion: Digital composition cannot advance physical evidence beyond BUILD_READY.
